digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate documentation and packaged guide
propositions: Authors must name risky runtime mechanisms whose correctness only resolves after a slow codified delivery loop (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning) and commit to a concrete fast out-of-loop proof before codifying.
The fast proof must be either a local run or a manual probe against the real target, clearly distinguished as T15 guidance.
Throwaway experiments must be cleaned up with teardown scoped only to resources they created, not the entire target environment.

The packaged guide and criterion registry must be regenerated and synchronized: criterion-pins.json via `rebar.llm.plan_review.guide_parity regenerate`, and registry.py module docstring updated from 32/T1–T12 to 44/T1–T15.
Hand-authored docs (docs/plan-review-gate.md and registry.py docstring) must reflect the validated 44 criteria across T1–T15 range, stack-agnostic (no Terraform or Docker specifics).
The new T15 guidance must be stack-agnostic, rendering via `rebar explain plan` without hardcoded product names or mechanism-specific instructions.
